game.purpose: The game build the patch list targets. scripts/build_selection_mcp.sh refuses any other build (release_info.json version + sts2.dll sha256 of the assembly dir it compiles against); a game update starts docs/version-migration-playbook.md.

sandbox_build.purpose: Worker/benchmark MCP: upstream commit + patches (in order) + scripts/McpHeadlessPatcher. Reproducible (SourceLink off, PathMap), so the DLL sha256 is checked per assembly dir.
sandbox_build.validated_2026_10_31: Built in this worktree and again outside any git repo: identical DLL. Same IL (718 method bodies) and user strings as the smoke-tested 768a44c9 build; only MVID and the informational version (no repo commit) differ. Isolated worker reported rules_context v0.111.0 / 41cef1ea / sts2.dll 9cb4f1ad and the eval API; stub run_bench smoke passed.

artifact.purpose: Historical: the unpatched upstream build for game 0.107.1. Unpatched upstream does not compile on v0.111.0; build_upstream_mcp.sh refuses other game versions. Workers never use it.

sandbox_patch.purpose: Disable optional Harmony UI patches and read the worker port from STS2_MCP_PORT.
